batch_settlement_restricted_to_validator.meaning: batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers are restricted to the validator role

standard_flows_kyc_gated.meaning: standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn revert when recipient (and holder for mint/burn) is not isKycVerified

source_funds_kyc_verified.meaning: funds to be moved sit at KYC-verified addresses

batch_settlement_kyc_gated.meaning: validator batch settlement (batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers) enforces the isKycVerified gate on recipients so funds cannot reach non-KYC recipients

integrator_kyc_guarantee_reliable.meaning: on-chain KYC guarantees remain reliable for downstream integrators relying on transfer gating (no non-KYC recipient reached via any transfer path)

assumptions: Batch settlement is invoked by a validator-role holder for arbitrary debtor/creditor pairs.
The token's standard flows enforce isKycVerified on recipients, so downstream integrators treat on-chain KYC gating as a guarantee.
The report frames the exposure as potential; no concrete amounts or addresses are given.

unresolved.description: Report does not state a concrete observable metric for 'KYC guarantees become unreliable'; the impact is expressed only qualitatively, so the relation is bound to a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric identity.

limitations: Formalizes only the integrator_exposure impact; the KYC-bypass and pause-bypass impacts are handled in separate passes.
The relation is a qualitative Boolean because the report supplies no numeric or address-level definition of integrator exposure.
Whether a batch call actually occurred and whether the token was paused are not established by the report.
